description: Everything needed to locate and correctly parse the CSV.

file._note: Give file_id for an exact match. Otherwise file_name is resolved within folder_id; the lookup fails loudly if the name is ambiguous.

header._note: header_row_number is 1-based and counts from the top of the file, so a 3-row preamble means header_row_number = 4. Ignored when has_header is false, in which case column order below defines the layout.

validation._note: deduplicate_on_primary_key keeps the first occurrence. Leave it false in bronze so duplicates surface rather than being silently dropped.
